caseName: New England Power Co. v. New Hampshire Public Utilities Commission
caseNameFull: New England Power Co. v. New Hampshire Public Utilities Commission Massachusetts v. New Hampshire Legislative Utility Consumers' Council and Roberts, Attorney General of Rhode Island v. New Hampshire Public Utilities Commission

opinions.text: Appeals from Sup. Ct. N. H. Motions of Edison Electric Institute and New England Power Tool Executive Committee for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Probable jurisdiction noted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 120 N. H. 866, 424 A. 2d 807.
